t: The $(5)Anti-Hostile Module$() is an optional module for the $(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)Interdiction Matrix$(). With this module installed, the Matrix is able to automatically detect hostile mobs that enter its scanning range and kill them - almost instantly. Players and non-hostile entities such as villagers and animals are not harmed.
$(5)反敌对生物模块$()是$(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)干涉矩阵$()的可选模块。安装此模块后，干涉矩阵将自动检测进入其扫描范围的敌对生物，并几乎瞬间将其击杀。玩家及非敌对实体（如村民和动物）则不会受到伤害。
